title: A released item leaves no stale work branch, and a worker's brief says how to free its branch for land
goal: backlog.py release deletes the item's empty work/<id> branch and a worktree-agent-* branch with no commits of its own, so the next worker's git checkout -b work/<id> succeeds and nothing is silently reset; the headless worker brief of the sprint run says to run git checkout --detach after its last commit until land frees the worktree itself; found by the first supervised run (ST-opjydjc3): the second and third runs found work/ST-xxxxxxxx and agent branches left by the blocked first run, and land asked the worker to detach by message
